# apple_app_age_rating_declaration (Resource)

Answers the content questionnaire behind an app's age rating.

Apple computes the rating from these answers; it is never set directly. The result appears as `app_store_age_rating` on `apple_app_info`.

The questions fall into three groups: how often a kind of content appears (the frequency attributes, each `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`), yes/no facts about what the app does, and the overrides that raise the computed rating.

~> **An unset answer is not `NONE`.** Apple leaves an omitted attribute exactly as it was, which for a new app means unanswered — and an unanswered questionnaire blocks the submission. Answer every question that applies rather than relying on a default. Each attribute is `Computed` as well as `Optional`, so an answer given in App Store Connect and not in the configuration is adopted rather than fought over.

~> **This resource adopts a record Apple already created; it does not create or destroy one.** Apple makes the declaration with the app and publishes neither `POST` nor `DELETE` for it. `terraform destroy` drops it from state and warns.

~> **Writes only land while a version is being prepared,** since the declaration hangs off the app's AppInfo.

Apple revised this questionnaire: `INFREQUENT` and `FREQUENT` belong to the newer form and `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD` and `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE` to the original, and `age_rating_override` was superseded by `age_rating_override_v2` (in which `SEVENTEEN_PLUS` became `EIGHTEEN_PLUS`). Both are accepted because an existing declaration may hold either. Attributes such as `age_assurance`, `loot_box`, `messaging_and_chat` and `user_generated_content` exist only on the newer form.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

# Apple computes the age rating from these answers; it is never set directly.
# The result appears as app_store_age_rating on apple_app_info.
#
# An unset answer is NOT the same as NONE -- Apple leaves an omitted attribute
# exactly as it was, which for a new app means unanswered, and an unanswered
# questionnaire blocks the submission. Answer every question that applies.
#
# This resource adopts the declaration Apple created with the app. It publishes
# neither POST nor DELETE for one, so terraform destroy drops it from state.
resource "apple_app_age_rating_declaration" "example" {
  app_id = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id

  # How often each kind of content appears. NONE, INFREQUENT_OR_MILD,
  # FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE, INFREQUENT or FREQUENT.
  alcohol_tobacco_or_drug_use_or_references        = "NONE"
  contests                                         = "NONE"
  gambling_simulated                               = "NONE"
  guns_or_other_weapons                            = "NONE"
  horror_or_fear_themes                            = "NONE"
  mature_or_suggestive_themes                      = "NONE"
  medical_or_treatment_information                 = "NONE"
  profanity_or_crude_humor                         = "NONE"
  sexual_content_graphic_and_nudity                = "NONE"
  sexual_content_or_nudity                         = "NONE"
  violence_cartoon_or_fantasy                      = "NONE"
  violence_realistic                               = "NONE"
  violence_realistic_prolonged_graphic_or_sadistic = "NONE"

  # Yes/no facts about what the app does. These belong to Apple's revised
  # questionnaire and did not exist on the original one.
  advertising                 = false
  age_assurance               = false
  gambling                    = false
  health_or_wellness_topics   = false
  loot_box                    = false
  messaging_and_chat          = false
  parental_controls           = false
  social_media                = false
  social_media_age_restricted = false
  unrestricted_web_access     = false
  user_generated_content      = false

  # An override can only raise the rating Apple computed, never lower it.
  age_rating_override_v2    = "NONE"
  korea_age_rating_override = "NONE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The Apple ID of the app this rating is for. Cannot be changed.

### Optional

- `advertising` (Boolean) Whether the app displays advertising.
- `age_assurance` (Boolean) Whether the app verifies a customer's age before showing age-restricted content.
- `age_rating_override` (String) Raises the rating Apple computed. One of `NONE`, `NINE_PLUS`, `THIRTEEN_PLUS`, `SIXTEEN_PLUS`, `SEVENTEEN_PLUS` or `UNRATED`. An override can only raise the rating, never lower it. Superseded by `age_rating_override_v2`.
- `age_rating_override_v2` (String) The revised override, in which `SEVENTEEN_PLUS` became `EIGHTEEN_PLUS`. One of `NONE`, `NINE_PLUS`, `THIRTEEN_PLUS`, `SIXTEEN_PLUS`, `EIGHTEEN_PLUS` or `UNRATED`.
- `alcohol_tobacco_or_drug_use_or_references` (String) References to or depictions of alcohol, tobacco or drug use. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `contests` (String) Contests the app runs. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `developer_age_rating_info_url` (String) A link to the developer's own explanation of the app's content, shown alongside the rating in territories that require one.
- `gambling` (Boolean) Whether the app offers real-money gambling. Apple rates any app answering `true` 18+ and restricts where it can be sold.
- `gambling_simulated` (String) Simulated gambling — casino games played with no real money at stake. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `guns_or_other_weapons` (String) Depictions of guns or other weapons. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `health_or_wellness_topics` (Boolean) Whether the app covers health or wellness topics.
- `horror_or_fear_themes` (String) Horror or fear themes. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `kids_age_band` (String) The Kids Category band the app is made for: `FIVE_AND_UNDER`, `SIX_TO_EIGHT` or `NINE_TO_ELEVEN`. Leave unset for an app that is not in the Kids Category, which is the usual case — the Kids Category carries extra review rules.
- `korea_age_rating_override` (String) Raises the rating shown in the Korean App Store specifically. One of `NONE`, `FIFTEEN_PLUS` or `NINETEEN_PLUS`.
- `loot_box` (Boolean) Whether the app sells loot boxes or any other randomised purchase.
- `mature_or_suggestive_themes` (String) Mature or suggestive themes. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `medical_or_treatment_information` (String) Medical or treatment information. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `messaging_and_chat` (Boolean) Whether customers can message or chat with each other.
- `parental_controls` (Boolean) Whether the app provides parental controls.
- `profanity_or_crude_humor` (String) Profanity or crude humor. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `sexual_content_graphic_and_nudity` (String) Graphic sexual content and nudity. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `sexual_content_or_nudity` (String) Sexual content or nudity. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `social_media` (Boolean) Whether the app includes social media features.
- `social_media_age_restricted` (Boolean) Whether those social media features are restricted by age.
- `unrestricted_web_access` (Boolean) Whether the app can open arbitrary web pages — an in-app browser with no filtering. Apple rates any app answering `true` at least 17+.
- `user_generated_content` (Boolean) Whether customers can post content other customers see.
- `violence_cartoon_or_fantasy` (String) Cartoon or fantasy violence. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `violence_realistic` (String) Realistic violence. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.
- `violence_realistic_prolonged_graphic_or_sadistic` (String) Prolonged graphic or sadistic realistic violence. One of `NONE`, `INFREQUENT_OR_MILD`, `FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE`, `INFREQUENT` or `FREQUENT`.

### Read-Only

- `app_info_id` (String) The AppInfo record the declaration hangs off. Resolved by the provider; Apple issues a new one each version cycle.
- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the declaration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import ID is the app's Apple ID: the declaration hangs off whichever app
# info record is currently editable, so the app is the only stable way to name
# it.
terraform import apple_app_age_rating_declaration.example 6478291043
```
